purpose: Teach: 念仏/党派/連隊/中退/白血病/リンパ/邁進/衰弱

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、終末期の患者さんの念仏を医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren, we make sure the medical team respects end-of-life patients' spiritual practices.
lines.style: Direct and clear, measured pace. Clinical but not cold. Slight warmth underneath the professional framework. Even breath, steady gaze.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、特定の党派への偏りなく医療チームで治療を提供します
lines.en: Yes — we provide treatment as a team, without bias toward any particular perspective.
lines.style: Gentle affirmation. Unhurried, almost reflective. A doctor clarifying something important without lecturing. Soft but weighted.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医師団は連隊のように動く必要があると、貴院、お考えなんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital believes the medical team needs to move like a coordinated unit, is that right, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, not challenging. Slight lean-in, testing whether he's understood correctly. Respectful but engaged, not deferential.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医学部中退者の再受験を医療チームで応援します
lines.en: Yes — and we support people reapplying to medical school, even if they've had to step away.
lines.style: Steady, factual. A principle stated simply. No apology, no fanfare. Breath even throughout, conveying quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 白血病外来の運営を、貴院、強化されてますね、先生
lines.en: I notice your hospital has been strengthening its leukemia outpatient services.
lines.style: Observant but not quite a question. A gentle statement that invites confirmation. Ren testing his own perception, asking the doctor to nod back.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、リンパ浮腫の治療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, lymphedema care is something the team takes on with particular attention.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, approving of the question. No elaboration needed — Ren has asked the right thing. Clinical but warm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療の質向上に邁進する姿勢、頼もしいです、先生
lines.en: It's reassuring to see how committed the hospital is to improving care quality.
lines.style: Sincere admiration, without flattery. Slow delivery, landing each word deliberately. Ren meaning what he says, speaking from genuine respect.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、衰弱した患者さんの栄養管理を医療チームで重視します
lines.en: Yes — nutritional care for our weakest patients is something we prioritize as a team.
lines.style: Calm and grounded. A statement of care made without sentimentality. Slight exhale after 'yes,' settling into the weight of what she's saying. Close, intimate register.
